in_scope: Create a standards-based DFMS governed run
Produce client checkpoints, token budget approvals, and change-control evidence
assumptions: Token estimates are rough SWAGs until decomposition and recon complete
Client approvals are required for budget expansion and scope rebaseline
scope_baseline.acceptance_definition: Client accepts an iteration only after trace, review, refinery, and checkpoint evidence pass.

assumptions: Scope remains within the approved iteration plan
No new brownfield repo recon is added after baseline

client_checkpoints.purpose: Confirm engagement model, owners, communication cadence, and initial constraints.
Approve in-scope work, out-of-scope exclusions, and acceptance definition.
client_checkpoints.reapproval_trigger: Any new requirement, changed acceptance criterion, or standards expansion

client_checkpoints.purpose: Approve rough token SWAG and reapproval thresholds.
client_checkpoints.reapproval_trigger: Token forecast increases by more than 15 percent

client_checkpoints.purpose: Approve iteration objectives, token bands, and checkpoint exits.
client_checkpoints.reapproval_trigger: Iteration objective, token SWAG, or exit gate changes

client_checkpoints.purpose: Approve impact analysis for any scope, token, schedule, quality, or risk change.
Approve delivered iteration artifacts and residual risks.
client_checkpoints.cadence_or_trigger: At iteration exit and release exit
client_checkpoints.reapproval_trigger: Any failed refinery gate or reopened risk

client_checkpoints.purpose: Approve lessons learned and process updates after each iteration.
client_checkpoints.cadence_or_trigger: After every iteration or failed gate
client_checkpoints.reapproval_trigger: Any lesson changes standards, templates, or token policy

iterations.objective: Harden engagement governance and token-budget approval gates.

change_control.rebaseline_trigger: Any material requirement, artifact, code, or process change after scope baseline

change_requests.description: Add token-budget approval gates to DFMS governance.

impact_analysis.tokens: Consumes additional validation and documentation tokens
impact_analysis.schedule: Adds a governance gate before material iterations
impact_analysis.risk: Reduces unapproved budget and scope drift
